::: {.hero}
# How on time are Island Transit's buses?

[Every few seconds, each Island Transit bus reports where it is, and each
report vanishes as soon as the next one arrives. This site saves all of them
and uses them to figure out how often the buses leave on time.]{.lede}

```{=html}
<p class="live unknown" id="live"><span class="dot" aria-hidden="true"></span><span><span class="live-state" role="status">Checking the collector…</span><span class="live-age"></span></span></p>
```
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
import {json, pct, count, lateness, longDate, routeMap, routeSlug, routeOrder, routeTitle, band, bandIcon, bandLegend, emptyNote, guard, stats, h, sparkline, splitBar, fmtShare} from "./lib.js"
import {drawRouteMap, routeSummary} from "./map.js"
recent = json("data/ontime/recent.json")
head = json("data/ontime/headline.json")
notes = json("data/quality/notes.json")
// The headline pools the last 28 service days across timetable changes
// (ontime/headline.json); a site built before that file existed falls back
// to the route tables' window.
useHead = head?.current?.observed > 0
o = useHead ? head.current : (recent?.overall ?? null)
lastDay = useHead ? head.last_service_date : recent?.last_service_date
nDays = useHead ? head.current.days : recent?.days
period = o == null ? "" : nDays === 1
  ? `on ${longDate(lastDay)}`
  : useHead ? `over the last ${nDays} days with service, to ${longDate(lastDay)}` : `over the ${nDays} days to ${longDate(lastDay)}`
```

::: {.slot-headline}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
guard(() => {
  if (o == null || !o.observed) return emptyNote("unavailable", "The on-time figures");
  const change = !useHead ? null
    : head.change_points != null
      ? `${Math.abs(head.change_points).toFixed(1)} points ${head.change_points >= 0 ? "higher" : "lower"} than the ${head.previous?.days ?? 28} service days before`
      : `Not enough days yet to compare with the ${head.window_service_days ?? 28} days before.`;
  const spark = useHead ? sparkline((head.spark ?? []).map(d => d.on_time_share_of_observed)) : null;
  const status = notes?.status;
  const trust = status == null ? null
    : status === "ok" || status === "note"
      ? html`<p class="trust">Our automatic checks found nothing wrong with the figures for ${longDate(notes.latest_service_date)}. <a href="quality.html">How good is the data?</a></p>`
      : html`<p class="trust">Our automatic checks flagged ${status === "problem" ? "a problem" : "something to look at"} in the figures for ${longDate(notes.latest_service_date)}. <a href="quality.html">See the data quality page</a>.</p>`;
  return html`<div class="headline">
      <div class="big">${pct(o.on_time_share_of_observed)}</div>
      <div class="big-text"><p class="big-label">of departures left on time ${period}.
        <span class="note">A bus counts as on time if it leaves from 1 minute early to 5 minutes late.${recent?.schedule_change ? ` Island Transit changed its schedule on ${longDate(recent.schedule_change.effective)}; the route tables below start over from that day.` : ""}</span></p>
        ${change ? html`<p class="change">${spark}<span>${change}</span></p>` : ""}
      </div>
    </div>
    ${splitBar(o)}
    ${stats([
      {label: "Typical departure", value: lateness(o.deviation_s_median)},
      {label: "More than 5 minutes late", value: fmtShare(o.late_share_of_observed)},
      {label: "Departures checked", value: count(o.observed)},
    ])}
    ${trust}
    <p class="how-measured"><a href="methods.html#on-time-performance">How we measured this</a></p>`;
}, "The on-time figures")
```
:::

## Every route at a glance

Pick any route on the map or from the list under it to see how it did at
each stop.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
L = require(new URL("vendor/leaflet-1.9.4/leaflet.js", document.baseURI).href)
mapData = routeMap(recent?.timepoints)
routeHref = id => `routes.html#${routeSlug(mapData.routes.find(r => r.route_id === id), id)}`
homeMap = {
  if (mapData == null || !Array.isArray(mapData.routes)) return null;
  const view = drawRouteMap(L, mapData, recent, {
    onSelect: id => { location.href = routeHref(id); },
    linkFor: routeHref,
  });
  invalidation.then(() => view.destroy());
  return view;
}
```

::: {.slot-map}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
guard(() => {
  if (homeMap == null) return emptyNote("unavailable", "The route map");
  const days = recent?.days ?? 0;
  const when = days > 1 ? `, last ${days} days` : days === 1 ? ", latest day" : "";
  const links = [...mapData.routes].sort(routeOrder).map(r => {
    const st = recent?.routes?.[r.route_id];
    const a = h("a", {href: routeHref(r.route_id), "aria-label": `${routeTitle(r)}: ${routeSummary(st)}`},
      bandIcon(band(st?.on_time_share_of_observed, st?.observed)), r.short_name || r.long_name || r.route_id);
    for (const on of ["mouseenter", "focus"]) a.addEventListener(on, () => homeMap.highlight(r.route_id));
    for (const off of ["mouseleave", "blur"]) a.addEventListener(off, () => homeMap.highlight(null));
    return h("li", {}, a);
  });
  return html`${homeMap.node}
    ${bandLegend({title: `Departures on time${when}`})}
    <nav class="route-links" aria-label="Routes"><ul>${links}</ul></nav>`;
}, "The route map")
```
:::

## How it works {#how-it-works}

```{=html}
<ol class="how-flow">
  <li><span class="who">Island Transit</span><span class="what">The bus</span><span class="does">GPS on board reports where it is</span></li>
  <li><span class="who">Island Transit</span><span class="what">The live feed</span><span class="does">what trip apps read; each update replaces the last one</span></li>
  <li class="ours"><span class="who">This project</span><span class="what">Our collector</span><span class="does">saves every update, every 20 seconds, day and night</span></li>
  <li class="ours"><span class="who">This project</span><span class="what">Nightly checks</span><span class="does">figure out when buses left each stop; grade the tracking data</span></li>
  <li class="ours"><span class="who">This project</span><span class="what">You</span><span class="does">this site's charts and map, plus every file to download</span></li>
</ol>
```

The feed tells us where a bus is, but it never says when the bus left a
stop. So the script traces every bus along its route, finds the moment it
passed each stop, and compares that moment with the printed timetable. The
same saved data also shows how often the tracking itself breaks down, which
you can see on the [Data quality](quality.qmd) page.

## Why this exists

Island Transit doesn't publish on-time figures, and once the live feed moves
on, its data is gone for good. Saving it lets anyone ask "Was route 60 late
last week?" and check the code behind the answer.
